title: Writing to a friend
topic: They are talking about a letter to a friend. Why will the woman enclose a photograph?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 友達への手紙について話しています。女の人は、どうして写真を入れますか。
turns.translation: They are talking about a letter to a friend. Why will the woman enclose a photograph?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 手紙を書いているんですか。今日は誰かの誕生日ですか。
turns.translation: Are you writing a letter? Is it someone's birthday today?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: いいえ、外国に住んでいる友達に書いています。来月、日本に来るそうです。
turns.translation: No, I'm writing to a friend who lives overseas. She says she's coming to Japan next month.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: その写真を手紙に入れるんですね。新しい家を見せたいんですか。
turns.translation: So you're putting that photo in the letter? Do you want to show her your new house?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 家の写真ではありません。髪を短くしたので、今の私の写真を送ります。空港ですぐ私が分かるように。
turns.translation: It's not a photograph of the house. I've cut my hair short, so I'm sending a current picture of myself, so she can recognize me straight away at the airport.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: なるほど。空港ではたくさんの人が待っていますからね。一枚で大丈夫ですか。
turns.translation: I see. There are lots of people waiting at the airport. Is one photo enough?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: はい。住所は前と同じですから、地図はいりません。写真と手紙だけ送ります。
turns.translation: Yes. My address is the same as before, so she doesn't need a map. I'll send just the photograph and letter.

options.label: 友達の誕生日を祝うためです。
options.rationale: The opening birthday guess is rejected.

options.label: 新しい家を見せるためです。
options.rationale: She explicitly says it is not a photograph of the house.

options.label: 空港で自分だと分かってもらうためです。
options.translation: To help her friend recognize her at the airport.
options.rationale: Her appearance has changed, and she states this recognition purpose.

options.label: 新しい住所を知らせるためです。
options.translation: To tell her friend her new address.

explanation: Listen for the purpose expressed by 分かるように. The letter sends a current appearance cue, not a new address or birthday gift.
